2f:["$","p",null,{"children":["Project and area mutations preserve authored-sync history and are attributed to the MCP agent.\nThey are unavailable to consumers with a permission scope, and are refused by a read-only server.\nProject reads return compact metadata: the canonical ",["$","code",null,{"children":"note_id"}]," plus ",["$","code",null,{"children":"areas"}]," and ",["$","code",null,{"children":"people"}]," association\nIDs; linked conversations, segments, messages, and topics are not expanded by these tools. Each\nassociation list is capped at 32 IDs and reports its full count plus a truncation flag. An update\nrejects more than 32 changed IDs for one association list, including a disjoint 32-to-32\nreplacement (64 changes), before changing the project fields."]}]
